title: ui: morph theme thumb icon with thumb position

commit.merge_subject: merge: ui: morph theme thumb icon with thumb position

description:
The icon inside the ThemeSlider thumb used to swap abruptly when the
thumb crossed a slot boundary. It is now drawn on a Canvas from the
same 24-unit path data as RitimIcons (Sun, AutoThemeA, Moon) and
morphed by the thumb position expressed in slots (0 sun, 1 A, 2 moon).

- sun to A: the eight rays retract into the disc, then the disc shrinks
  and fades while the A scales and turns in (short crossfade overlap)
- A to moon: the A shrinks and turns out while the crescent rotates and
  scales in
- the morph is a pure function of thumbX (smoothstep-based), so it
  follows the finger while dragging, plays during the settle spring and
  reverses cleanly; at each rest position exactly one glyph is drawn
  untransformed, identical to the static icon (stroke 1.75, round caps)
